calendarFaqs.q: Which Arlington ISD calendar should elementary parents use in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the Elementary Student Academic Calendar for elementary-specific notes and early dismissals. The combined date list on this page covers the first and last days, holidays and major breaks that also appear on the secondary calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Do Arlington ISD elementary and secondary students have the same early-dismissal dates?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Elementary early dismissal is December 18, 2026, and May 26, 2027. Secondary early dismissal is December 17–18, 2026, and May 25–26, 2027. Confirm the dismissal time with the assigned campus.

calendarFaqs.q: Do Early College High School and A/B students use this Arlington ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use this page for the combined elementary and secondary dates, then check the official Early College High School or Student A/B Calendar for program-specific dates and alternating-day schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: Are March 26 and April 23 confirmed days off in Arlington ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: They are listed as student/staff holidays and bad weather make-up days. They remain days off unless Arlington ISD announces that one is needed to recover instructional time.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for Arlington ISD calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official Arlington ISD calendars page and the assigned campus for revisions, emergency closures, dismissal times, testing, athletics and other school-specific events.

customSections.label: Arlington ISD 2026-2027 Calendar Quick Answer
customSections.content: For quick planning, the Arlington ISD 2026-2027 school year starts on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 and ends on Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Major student breaks include Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break.

customSections.label: Arlington ISD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content:
The Arlington ISD 2026-2027 academic calendar is published as separate elementary and secondary student calendar PDFs. The calendars share the same first day, last day, major holidays, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, parent conference days, student holidays, and bad weather make-up days.

This MySchoolDates page combines duplicate shared dates into one Arlington ISD calendar reference and keeps the elementary and secondary differences visible where the official PDFs differ. Families should use this page for quick planning, then confirm the official elementary, secondary, A/B, or Early College High School calendar that applies to their student.

customSections.label: How Arlington ISD Calendar Data Is Collected
customSections.content: MySchoolDates starts with the official Arlington ISD calendars page and the published elementary and secondary student academic calendar PDFs. Calendar dates are extracted from those official sources, duplicate shared dates are merged, grade-level differences are preserved, and the resulting records are used to generate the searchable date list, printable PDF, and one-time calendar import file.

groups.label: Data workflow
items: Review the official Arlington ISD calendar page and student academic calendar PDFs.
Extract first day, last day, holidays, breaks, parent conference dates, early dismissals, and bad weather make-up days.
Remove duplicate shared dates between elementary and secondary calendars.
Keep grade-level differences visible when elementary, secondary, A/B, or Early College calendars differ.
Generate the MySchoolDates calendar file from the reviewed date records.

customSections.label: Campus-Level Arlington ISD Calendar Note
customSections.content: This page focuses on districtwide Arlington ISD calendar dates and published grade-level calendar differences. Campus events such as testing assignments, graduation ceremonies, athletics, performances, field trips, bell schedules, club activities, and individual school events may differ from this districtwide calendar. Families should confirm campus-level details with their assigned school before making final plans.

customSections.label: How We Verify Arlington ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Arlington ISD calendars page and published elementary and secondary student academic calendar PDFs, deduplicates shared districtwide dates, preserves grade-level differences such as early dismissal schedules, and compares major dates including first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, parent conference days, student holidays, and bad weather make-up days.

The official Arlington ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
